source: Wordify MCP server tool schemas, as exposed to this session

openapi_document.note: The document is behind console authentication. An unauthenticated request returns the console SPA shell rather than JSON, so no HTTP paths, request/response schemas, auth header name, error codes, scope names or idempotency mechanism could be verified from it.

get_me.returns: the authenticated user plus an inline list of every team they belong to
get_me.notes: Orientation call. For multi-team users a team is selected before site, billing or task calls.

list_sites.http_confidence: stated in the tool description; the only HTTP path this session could verify

parameters.site_id: 26-char base32 ULID or a bare domain
parameters.include: php_config, cdn_config, cache_config, basic_auth, redis, wordpress_settings, cron_config, plugins, themes, team, wp_options

get_site.authorisation: enforced by the site policy; a token scoped to one team cannot read sites on another team

list_domains.returns: every domain attached to the site, primary first then newest

parameters.domain: without www prefix, public TLD only, max 253 chars
parameters.make_primary: default false; promotes to primary once DNS verifies

add_domain.behaviour: creates a parked domain pointer, then asynchronously verifies DNS and provisions an SSL certificate; returns the created domain record immediately

recheck_domain_dns.behaviour: synchronous; refreshes dns_verified_at and ssl_state for every domain on the site
recheck_domain_dns.side_effects: live DNS queries and, when SSL state is missing or stale, a fresh Let's Encrypt issuance request
recheck_domain_dns.rate_limit: Let's Encrypt rate-limits per registered domain per week; tight retry loops must be avoided

not_verified.http_paths: Every path except GET /api/v1/sites. Not guessed.
not_verified.auth_header: The bearer header name and format could not be read from the specification.
not_verified.response_envelopes: Field names beyond those the tool schemas state.
not_verified.error_codes: HTTP status codes and error body shape for refusals, rate limits and conflicts.
not_verified.idempotency: Whether the API exposes an idempotency key on writes, and under what header or field.
not_verified.abilities: The exact token ability/scope names, and whether a token can be restricted to a single site rather than a team.
not_verified.domain_detachment: No domain deletion or detachment operation is exposed by the MCP surface, and none could be confirmed from the specification.
